nom: Kate Somerville Goat Milk Moisturizing Cleanser

avis.texte: I was advised by an employee that for my age and skin this would be cleansing but gentle. Love this product!
I really like the goat milk cleasnser. It makes my skin feel soft and clean.
I tried several cleanser and always ended going back to the goat milk cleanser. My skin is very sensitive and thus cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean and hydrated.

avis.titre: Very calming but acne girly beware
avis.texte: At first I loved this product. Very calming and hydrating, cleans well and smells so nice. However I would frequently get terrible what i thought was hormonal acne on my chin/neck. I recently ran out of this produce switched to a gentle drugstore cleanser and its been a month and my acne is gone. I know this product contains coconut oil which can contribute to acne, so while I loved it I think people with acne prone skin should be careful with this product. However, I still really love the Hydrakate moisturizer and recommend that to anyone with acne prone skin!

I'm not a fan of cream cleansers, however this full line works amazing. I live in a dry state, so need extra moisture, but struggle with finding the right one that won't strip my skin, yet still leaves me feeling clean. I'm a huge fan of this, and have noticed moisture retention in my face with a glow.

I received this as a free sample and I will likely purchase this product after finishing it. I have combination skin that often gets red, flaky, and dry. After 3wks of use, I've noticed a signifcant improvement in the plumpness of my skin and evenness of texture and moisture. I'm in my mid 20's and this has helped plump back out fine lines that had been beginning to appear. I typically use gel-based cleansers, but now I am a huge fan of this creamy consistency for its hydration. Needs to be paired with pore-minimizing products however such as niacinimiade because I have noticed that my pores have increased in size while using this product.

I really enjoy this face wash. The smell is nostalgic to me, I think my mom used goat milk lotion when I was younger because the smell brings me back to memories of my mom. It smells good to me. It is supposed to be moisturizing, and while I think it makes my skin feels soft and clean, it does have a certain "tightness" that would require an additional moisturizer. I am happy so far with this product.
This stuff feels so good on my skin I literally look forward to using it. I never consistently washed my face (even before bed 😳) and with this im cleansing twice a day. LOVE love this cleanser
I think this is my new all-time favorite cleanser wow, so gentle yet my skin feels clean and soothed. love this!

avis.titre: So many compliments on my skin!
avis.texte: I switched to Kate Somerville products almost three months ago. Ive teied everything under the sun, but am completely blown away by the improvement in my skin's appearance, feel, texture… everything! I have always had a hard time keeping up with an am/pm routine, but with Kate, i look forward to spending 10-15 minutes every morning and evening with these luxurious products. I almost have the whole line! Definitely start with this goat milk cleanser. It's incredible!

Used to have really bad acne and broke out using so many different products just to try and clear my skin but THIS works cleared my skin within the 1st month and now i live by this! This will be my forever cleanser also doesnt smell bad which is a huge plus because i hate chemical smelling cleansers 10/10 recommend I have combination skin which tends to go super dry after cleansing and oily in shortly after and this gives my skin the perfect balance for a normal feel.

I have oily skin and wear a full face everyday. Whenever i use this cleanser my face always feels freah and really clean. I love the soft scent so much! My fave never feels striped. It always leaves it soft and silky.

I had my eyes on this cleanser for a few months and when the time came around to purchase a new cleanser I was so excited to finally try this. The ingredient makeup seemed like it was going to be ideal for my skin. The consistency of this is more comparable to a gel cleanser than a milk cleanser in my opinion. That being said; it acted like a gel cleanser as well. I gave it multiple tries; but it left my skin stripped (like the post-castile soap tight/dry feeling) so I ended up returning. That alone is enough to make me run for the hills; but if you have any sort of sensitivies to fragrance beware this is an incredibly fragranced product; due to this I experience some sensitivity near the eye area (obviously not in or on my eye). Steer clear if you like having a moisture barrier!

I have been wanting to try this forever, and since I have, I'll never turn back. I have dry-combination skin with psoriasis, and this cleanser is so beautiful for my skin. It never leaves me feeling stripped, it's so creamy and my skin feels so clean and moisturized after. I love the subtle, natural smell to it. I love when I get to use it and look forward to it. The beautiful thing is that Ulta frequently has it on sale… it's not always loud so be on watch. I now have two bottles in back stock since I've purchased my first and I have yet to pay full price. Stock up on sale, girlies. TRY on sale - so worth it. We've been lucky but I'd pay full price for this, easy.

avis.titre: Beware, this is a staple item!
avis.texte: I've had an issue with breakouts since I was a teenager and this has cleared it all right up! I've switched back to Thayers, which used to do well with my skin, only to break out horribly while I await my new bottle. Seriously, get it.

avis.titre: Finally, a cleanser for my reactive skin
avis.texte: My skin reacts to everything. I have to suffer through most trials before finding whats gonna work. At 33, I had yet yo gind a cleanser that didnt leave most of my skin with that tight, stripped feeling- or not clean at all. This is it!! After a couple pf weeks. I can safely say I'll never buy another cleanser as this exists. Its worth the price to finally have something that works on my whole face, not just my t zone or just my cheeks. My forehead and cheeks get super dry, I have oily acne prone nose- but this helped with it all. Hydrating for cheeks and forehead, but cleansing enough for my nose. Very little goes a long way too! Love love love
I've been using this cleanser for a few years & love it. I have sensitive skin and I can use it daily with no problem. And it leaves my face feeling clean and refreshed.

I love this creamy milky face cleanser because I sometimes develop flakiness around the T zone but when I use the Goat Milk cleanser it clears it up and moisturizes my face and that feels very fresh and clean.

It's such a luxurious cream cleanser! Effective, rinses well without leaving any residue, but also without leaving my skin dry. My dehydrated skin loves it. I usually use unscented products because I'm very sensitive to smells, but this has a very pleasant, not overpowering scent. Absolutely recommend!

Im a fan of switching up certain products, and face wash is one of them. I use this one whenever my skin is feeling dry or itchy. If I have used other products recently that irritated my skin, then I reach for this one because I know it will work but feel very mild. I read another review that said it smelled bad. I have not had that experience. Smells nice to me.
Love this cleanser. It doesn't make your skin feel tight when you're finished cleansing it. It feels soft and smooth.
The BEST face wash I've ever used! It has completely hydrated and turned my skin around. If you're not using this, you should be!

Amazing product! The consistency is just creamy enough that it lathers on nicely without it being too thick and suffocating or too thin and watery. Leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed and hydrated. This is without a doubt the holy grail of cleansers!

I started with the small bottle of the exfolikate miracle mask and finally decided to get the entire line. Thoroughly enjoying it all. I love and work in a very hot and humid environment and these products help keep the oil and dirt out and keep clogged pores at bay.
I love all of the Kate products. I have dealt with hormonal, cystic and fungal acne for 10 years. These products have saved my face.
This cleanser has helped my skin be softer, feel cleaner and fresher, help to diminish dark spots and rosy cheeks. I use it daily and have seen improvement in my trouble areas
I normally love Kate Somerville products, but the smell of this cleanser is awful. It smells like feet and definitely isn't something I want to put near or on my face. Very disappointing.
This cleanser leaves your skin soft and doesn't dry it out. The scent is nice but not overpowering. I use it twice a day.

I brought this on vacation to me to the Caribbean and used it to wash my face twice a day as I swim in a pool with chlorine and I swim in the ocean. Let me tell you my face felt like brand new skin each time I used it I so look forward to washing my face with this and I can honestly say this will be one of the best face washes you've ever tried

I love this product. I have very sensitive skin and found this product to be non irritating and gentle to my skin and not leaving it to be dried out. I have been using it for over a year and I don't think I could use another product that works this well.

This stuff is absolutely amazing!!!! I've struggled for so long to find a face wash that doesn't dry my skin out and helps my redness among other things and this stuff has helped my redness SO much and my face is so smooth and moisturized. BUY IT !! Can't say enough good things.
My favorite thing about this cleanser is the fragrance. It's so lovely. I also find the creamy texture to be soothing and moisturizing.

Smells amazing and works great to take off my makeup. I double cleanse using this first and then the exfolikate daily cleanser. My skin feels soft and clean after and I haven't had any breakouts from it.

I have super dry skin to the point where I was exfoliating & dry brushing too often because it felt like the only option to get rid of my flaky skin before a night out. This face wash single handedly saved my skin. I no longer have flaky facial skin and it has helped even out my skin tone as well. Amongst all of the very expensive moisturizers that I've tried, this product has made the most obvious difference!

avis.titre: Black Woman Review for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I recently switched from Dermalogica Daily Microexfoliant to this product. This is the is off the chain for sensitive skin. I am unsure if it has real goat milk but my skin feels squeaky clean after piling serums, moisturizer, and sunscreen. Please bear in mind I do not wear makeup, therefore I cannot speak for those that want to use this cleanser to remove makeup. I am a simple girl that use to suffer from severe acne. I am giving my honest review and I was not paid or even sent this product. Thanks for reading my honest reviews.
Used this one time and was amazed by the results. My skin feels so soft and all of my blackheads around my nose are gone! 10/10 would recommend for people with sensitive skin.
This is the best cleanser I have ever used! I have sensitive dry skin and it's helped my skin so much especially in the colder months! I 10/10 recommend this to anybody!
Best facial cleanser on the market. I have oily and dry skin around T zones and it has helped tremendously.
This product is very rich and gorgeous to use. It's very pricey but seems worth the splurge.

I purchase this product looking for something that would clean and not leave my face dry. This did the trick. It's a little on the pricey side, but u only need about a pea amount. Plan on purchasing again.

avis.titre: I would buy again and highly recommend it
avis.texte: I'm liking it so far. I have the other one with the sulfur in it and I like that one too. This one is milder and soft. I have only used it about a week and I really like it a lot.
Thank goodness for boxy charm when I got this to test our. I've been through 3 bottles already. It's my go to

got this in a boxycharm and didn't think much of it at first. but the more i was using it the more i loved it. my face feels clean after washing without drying it out at all. i have sensitive, reactive, dry-combo skin and this was so great for all of those things. absolutely recommend

This product with the moisturizing cream literally changed my life! I've had a bad butterfly redness on my face for 10 years due to side effects of an autoimmune disease. On day 2, I already noticed a difference and so did other people! After a 1.5 weeks it was completely gone! And it leaves my skin feeling softer than it ever has.
At first my skin was really soft but then i started breaking out pretty bad.. I went back to my old products (dermalogica) and the breaking out stopped :(

I love this cleanser! I originally got it in a Boxycharm but was scared to use it because I had oily skin and struggled with acne around my chin. Instead, I was using a salicylic acid cleanser which never helped. I decided to try this because I read that I need to keep skin moisturized and heal my skin barrier and my acne has been clearing up so much!! I use this with Cerave retinol and it has been amazing! It makes my skin so soft and has a very gentle fragrance.

avis.titre: This stuff is so gentle and hydrating
avis.texte: You'll love it if you want to splurge on cleanser. Leaves your skin baby soft and hydrated.

This was my HG for several years, I loved how soothing it felt and did a decent job cleansing without stripping my sensitive skin. However I can no longer use it. I don't know if formula or ingredient or ingredient source has changed, but this now burns my face within a few seconds of application, and the last time I tried to use it caused a breakout as well. I'm pretty bummed.
i received this in my boxycharm a few months back. it's good but i don't think worth the price personally. it does have a scene to it but i personally loved it

Absolutely love the goat milk products from Kate Somerville! I had perfect skin until I was 29, then my rosacea started to flare. This product helps me recognize the person in the mirror and does wonders for my self-esteem in relation to my rosacea. Absolute must try for those with red, sensitive skin. Also smells heavenly and hydrates well. To me, it's definitely worth the price.
This is such a great product! I got it in fitfabfun box and I am seriously obsessed!! And it smells amazing as well I will be buying this again!
never going to buy again. This cleanser is not good for acne prone skin type. I got lots of acne and clog pore after using this product.
I'm obsessed w this cleaner. Perfect for dry skin, but also exfoliates! 😍
I got this in my boxycharm but I love it so much I'm buying more from ulta!
I love this cleanser! It makes my skin so soft and has not broke me out! I recommend it! It also smells good but it's not a strong scent.
Got this from boxy charm but it's so amazing!! Buying more from ulta now 😂

I have been searching for the perfect face wash for my face for what feels like years. I am 31 and starting to see early signs of aging and always worry about stripping my face when I wash it. I am so thrilled that this leaves my face feeling clean, soft and moisturized. I don't think I'll ever stop using this now that I've found it!

I absolutely love this cleanser! It is so hydrating while doing a great job at making me feel clean. My face is so supple and moisturized after just one week of use ,and I have noticed my skin looks clear! I usually go for cleansers that are more foaming or have some sort of exfoliating acid because of my combo skin sometimes leaning oily.... But this cleanses so nicely and lathers well! It just does a fantastic job at cleansing while not feeling dry or stripped at all!! This is the perfect time of year for me to use it when I start leaning a little dry. Worth the money for sure!! I'm obsessed!
I am on my 5th bottle of this face wash! It is creamy, non foaming, and I feel no skin tightness after washing my face with this. I also love the scent.

avis.titre: Very moisturizing cleanser for mature skin
avis.texte: My SIL gave me a sample of this and I fell in love with it. I love how it feels on my skin, and I've noticed an improvement in my skin's firmness and texture as a result. The only downside is that it did not mix well with an eye cream I was using from Maelove that had caffeine in it. Something about the two together made the skin around my eyes burn, so I stopped using the eye cream because I love the cleanser more. The smell is really pleasant too - kind of sweet with hints of vanilla, but not overwhelming.
It's a creamy texture once it's on but didn't do anything to improve my skin at all

Awesome cleanser! You immediately notice how silky and lush this product is as soon as you put it on your skin. It leaves my face feeling not only clean but hydrated without a greasy residue. It can be expensive but you really only need a pea size amount of product so it does last. This is my new go to cleanser for my second cleanse at night and my only cleanse in the morning.

avis.titre: One of my all time favorite cleansers!
avis.texte: I love this cleanser so much! It definitely is on the pricier end, but it always leaves my skin feeling so good! I generally don't even have to take off my makeup with a wipe before I use this product, I will use this and it will get all of it off even my mascara. It smells amazing and it usually takes me some time to get through one tube (I finished 2 this year so I guess for me they last roughly 6 months!)

I use this cleanser as my 2nd cleanse at night after I use a balm/oil to remove my make-up. It doesn't sting my eyes, nor strip/dry out my aging skin. A little pea size amount is all you need for excellent results.
Hated it! The scent and texture cause me a lot of irritation and didn't really make my skin feel clean.

avis.titre: Great for my sensitive acne prone skin
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin and have been using this now for a few months, and its been great. Doesnt make me dry or oily, is just right. No new breakouts or redness, I've found my facewash, finally!

avis.titre: If I don't have a backstock I freak out
avis.texte: Great for all types of skin, even when I'm breaking out it's a reliable friend. I keep in daily rotation

I have been looking for a cleanser for some time that doesn't burn my skin the minute it goes on. I have very sensitive skin and even products designed for sensitive skin cause redness and irritation. I was skeptical about the goat milk, but I was proven so wrong! It makes my skin feels soft and bouncy, not parched, after I use it. It has a nice smell, like something your grandma would use (but not overly floral like the ladies at the church). A little goes a long way. I highly recommend and am buying my second bottle so that I don't run out!

I've been in the market for a new cleanser, something relatively gentle, and not full of harsh ingredients. I got the Kate Somerville Goats Milk moisturizer in a FabFitFun box a few months ago and loved it so I figured why not try the matching moisturizer. This stuff is amazing! My skin feels clean after every use but not dry or stripped down. I've noticed zero irritation in switching from old Drunk Elephant cleanser to this one. And it smells great but not overpowering at all!

avis.titre: This is my 3 purchase of this
avis.texte: I love love LOVE this cleanser, it has a nice smell to it, it's so gentle on the skin, so hydrating and doesn't leave your skin oily or anything. This is the best thing for your skin in my opinion.

I have dry skin so I don't really like using any foaming cleansers. This cleanser is my absolute favorite. I have tried finding dupes for it and have been unsuccessful thus far. The CeraVe hydrating cleanser is just not creamy enough for me. I love the thickness of the goat milk cleanser and I feel it really does clean my skin. I love it!
This is my holy grail cleanser. Very moisturizing and doesn't strip your face. I always make sure I have a back up of this product.

I was using the CeraVe daily foaming cleanser for a year for my extremely oily skin and it really helped, but i recently moved to a dryer, colder climate and my skin has been simultaneously oily/acne prone with dry patches! I realized my skin needed something that wouldnt strip the skin like the cerave was doing, but after trying their hydrating cleanser i broke out even more! I decided to splurge on this product because i was desperate and the reviews were good, and i can confirm it has been 100% worth it. I was nervous because of the coconut oil and fragrance, but neither are large quantities and for someone that typically breaks out from that kind of thing, i havent had a single breakout appear in the past 2 weeks i have been using this product. My skin feels hydrated and this stuff really does clean the skin without stripping it. Its so gentle and i really like the texture/consistency of it over jellt cleansers. I only use a pea sized amount and i find that its plenty, so i have a feeling this will last me a long time. I would still recommend trying a drugstore brand/ cheaper cleanser and if that works for you, great! But for someone who has tried what feels like hundreds of drugstore cleansers and most recently the CeraVe ones, i think you do really get what you pay for. If youre looking to splurge on a higher end cleanser, this would be a really great option!

I have dry/sensitive skin and have used the CeraVe hydrating cleanser religiously for years. I've experimented with lots of other face washes and always went back to that one b/c my skin would get overly dry and/or break out. But i felt like it wasn't doing enough. I bought this as a treat/based off of the good reviews and I love it! I think it's worth the price because using a pea sized amount when i wash my face is plenty and so far I've used this for about 2-3 months and have half the tube left. I've noticed an improvement in the tone and texture of my skin with no reactions so it's been worth the price tag for me.
Been using this for a couple of weeks now and I have to say it makes my face very smooth.
I love the way it smells, but it's way too expensive. You can go through this quickly and it's not as moisturizing as I thought it would be. My CeraVe is more moisturizing

The sales person suggested this and the goat milk moisturizer for my redness. I've had terribly red/combo/acne prone skin for over 2 decades. I noticed a difference after 1 use. After 2 days, my redness was nearly gone!

I have very sensitive skin and was using the neutrogena hydroboost cleanser prior to this one. I love the hydroboost collection. However the cleanser made my face feel really dry and at times itchy. Decided to try this one thanks to a recommendation and I LOVE IT! It smells AMAZINGGG and feels very nice on the skin! Super hydrating and soothing!

received this as a platinum perk, used it all up and had to purchase one. I have REALLY SENSITIVE skin and this works great, removes my makeup, after pre-cleansing, and doesn't leave my face dry. Definitely recommend and would definitely repurchase!
this is like heaven. leaves my skin soft and cleansed. pricy ,but worth every penny.

avis.titre: Has a scent and broke me out
avis.texte: I got this for being a diamond member earlier this year, but hadn't really used it much until I ran out of my usual cleanser. The coconut oil in this product breaks me out as it is pore clogging. Also, I can't get past the "goat milk" fragrance because it's not how my goat milk soap bars smell...just glad I didn't pay this price for something that didn't work out for me.
I have very dry, easily irritated skin. This is so gentle and non stripping; it is pricey, but I only use a little and will repurchase.
This has got to be THE best smelling cleanser in the entire world. Like, I could almost drink it, it smells so good. It's so creamy and amazing. Seriously love it.

I got this product for free and at 26 I finally fell in love with a face cleanser, however I agree with everyone that I can't get myself to pay for this consistently so I hunted down anything similar. If you have sensitive skin try the bare minerals line or anything with goat milk! I don't think anything can compare to this product though. I'm a splurger on beauty but I run through face wash fast so I really wish it was cheaper!

avis.titre: I really do love this ridiculously priced cleanser
avis.texte: This cleanser smells heavenly, rinses easily and leaves my skin feeling smooth. I really do like it. I picked it up with a 20% off coupon and have no regrets. However, I'm not sure if I would continue to purchase this at regular price. That is no fault of this product, I just struggle to pay this much for any cleanser. I'd rather focus my skincare budget on actives rather than cleansers which stay on my skin for half a minute. Bottom line, if you like a bit of luxury and willing to pay for it, I have no problem recommending this.

I did not want to spend this much money on a cleanser, but after reading so many positive reviews online, I decided to try it out. In the past, cleansers have not been my best friend. They dry out my already dry skin. They irritate my skin. They make my face feel tight after washing. This cleaner is so gentle and smooth. My face looks and feels radiant after I wash, even before I moisturize. I'm able to use this cleaner am and pm, and I've never been able to do that before. I've been using this product for about 6 weeks now, and my skin has noticeably improved. I've already purchased a second bottle for when this one runs out! I love it, and will be repurchasing again and again.

This stuff is just amazing. Nothing leaves my skin as soft, clear, balanced and glowy as this. I have dehydrated, oily, acne prone skin and this is the only face wash i've found that moisturizes my skin without making it look too oily, doesn't strip my skin but clears my acne and calms my redness. Amazing and completely worth the money.
I like this product. It feels nice and gentle. Cleans skin well. Makes skin feel soft and moisturized.

I love the Kate Somerville line especially the face cleansing products. This product smells great, is gentle in the face and still takes makeup off. I will use a makeup remover first and then use the facial cleanser to ensure that I have removed all my makeup.

It doesn't strip your skin and leave it dry and it doesn't leave a oily cast either, it's very creamy and has a slight scent but it isn't bad at all. I have very sensitive, oily, acne prone skin and it hasn't broken me out, I love this cleaner works great!
It makes my skin feel so soft and fabulous! It's so gentle in the skin.
This is a great product that leave your skin feeling fabulous.. I love that it is gentle yet effective!!
Have been using it twice a day for a week and my skin is bouncy and soft.

I was so pleasantly surprised by this cleanser. I've been using it morning and night and my skin feels so smooth and hydrated after using. I think it might be my new HG cleanser. As a bonus, if smells great too.

I also got this as a diamond perk. I have used the old formula and this one is much improved. The old one separated and hardened into globs that resembled hardened honey making it difficult to get out of the tube. It was also very balm like bordering on greasy. This version is white and fluffy; hydrating but not oily. It rinses off nicely. I have very dry skin but think anyone could use this. It has much better mass appeal that the original formula which I would not have repurchased. I would still double cleanse if wearing a full face of makeup but one cleanse with this is perfect for a morning cleanse or a minimal makeup evening cleanse. It's very pleasant to use and I'm glad I had another opportunity to try it. It leaves my skin feeling clean and smooth.
This stuff smells phenomenal. My skin feels so smooth and clean. I don't want to speak too soon but this may be my new cleanser. Thank you Ulta for rewarding your Diamond members!
love Kate Somerville and I love being a diamond member. thank you ulta! this product is amazing and makes my skin feel so soft and clean!
Anything this company makes works and does what it says. The $$ is worth it. If your a Diamond Member like me you wont believe the perks!!! Outstanding
